rounds.name: Gulf of Corinth
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Corinth is a deep inlet of the Ionian Sea that separates the Peloponnese from western mainland Greece.

rounds.name: Baffin Island Coast
rounds.fact: Baffin Island in the Canadian territory of Nunavut is the largest island in Canada and is bounded by Baffin Bay.

rounds.name: Gulf of Thailand
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Thailand is a shallow inlet in the southwestern South China Sea bounded by Cambodia, Thailand, and Vietnam.

rounds.name: Walvis Bay
rounds.fact: Walvis Bay is a coastal port on the Atlantic coast of Namibia sheltered by the Pelican Point sand spit.

rounds.name: North Island / Bay of Plenty
rounds.fact: The Bay of Plenty is a bight along the northern coast of New Zealand’s North Island renowned for geothermal activity.
